answer: Make each bond jointly liable: deposits from one funding source share a slashing pool, so when any key is caught the whole family's collateral is cut. An honest agent funds one key and bears only its own risk, solid as relic granite. A farm spreading fakes from a common well turns every caught head into a loss across all its siblings — the shale-thin margin of a single fake's payout cannot cover a karst network of linked forfeitures, so scaling the farm scales its own downside.
